_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for money. Consumed by the product page (display), the cart (add-on display), the checkout API (server-authoritative charge amount), and scripts/sync-stripe-catalogue.mjs (Stripe catalogue). Change a price HERE and nowhere else. All values are USD whole dollars.

lights._comment: LED loupe lights. Corded lights are priced per battery option; wireless lights have one price. Each light and battery is priced at about 1.75x landed cost, rounded to end in 5 (2026-10-27).

lightBundle._comment: Percent off each light when the same order includes a pair of loupes.

trainee._comment: Verified resident, fellow and student promotion (15% from 2026-10-02). Applied at checkout with a Stripe promotion code that the team sends by hand after checking proof of training status, so the server still charges catalogue prices from this file. The site shows the percentage only, never a discounted price.
